purpose: frozen candidate held-out, stress and diagnostic simulator closed-loop evaluation

stress.construction: simulation fixtures from training demonstrations only; exact state interventions with separate truth
stress.occluded_requires_unknown: both views fully hidden; single-view occlusions reported separately

recipe.held: Last training-demo state before first success where MuJoCo reports gripper contact grasping tomato sauce; report missing fixture if none exists
recipe.above_basket: First successful training state, translate tomato sauce 0.20 m upward with pose otherwise fixed; require native success false
recipe.wrong_object: First successful training state, exchange tomato sauce and bbq sauce free-joint positions; require native success false
recipe.occluded: First successful training state, replace external view, wrist view, then both views with zero RGB; report separately; both hidden must abstain
recipe.dropped_after_placement: First successful training state followed by tomato sauce displaced 0.30 m laterally and lowered to table height; require true-to-false native success transition; controlled state fixture, not an observed spontaneous policy drop

closed_loop.mode: diagnostic simulator experiment; never changes existing release gates
instructions: Please put the tomato sauce in the basket.
Move the tomato sauce container into the basket.
Pick up the tomato sauce and place it in the basket.
